title: selfhost: cut StreamJsonParser ns/line with the hash-guarded bench
body: Crucible optimizing its own agent-stream decoder. The candidate is crucible-harness/src/stream_json.rs; the score is ns per input line over the bench corpus, lower wins, target under 450 from a ~890 baseline. The gate is the pack's own: the injected bench (crucible-harness/benches/stream_json.rs) hashes the emitted event stream and refuses to score a candidate whose events changed, so a decoder that drops or reshapes events reports invalid rather than fast.
justification: Demo: crucible optimizing its own agent-stream decoder with a gate it cannot game.
